ov: يي يي هو فيلم دراما تايواني من تأليف وإخراج إدوارد يانغ وبطولة وو نيان جين، إيلاين جين وجوناثان تشانغ.
plotEn:
The Jians—father NJ, mother Min-Min, daughter Ting-Ting, and son Yang-Yang—are a middle-class family that stay in an apartment in Taipei. The film begins at the wedding of Min-Min's younger brother A-Di, who is marrying his pregnant mistress. NJ runs into his ex-girlfriend Sherry, who inquires why he left her 30 years go. They are interrupted, but Sherry gives him her number before leaving. Sherry is married to a Chinese-American and lives in Chicago. After the reception, Min-Min's mother, who lives with the family, suffers a stroke on the ground floor that leaves her comatose. She is put on life support and the doctor urges the Jians to talk to her daily. Min-Min, having trouble continuously conversing with her mother, becomes depressed and leaves for a remote Buddhist retreat.
NJ is dissatisfied with his life, and his company is struggling financially. To secure a client named Mr. Ota, NJ's colleagues ask him to take Ota out for dinner, to which he reluctantly agrees. NJ tells Ota about Sherry, who happens to be a mutual, and how NJ left Sherry due to differences in outlook of music. They get along well and NJ takes Ota to a bar, where Ota sings and plays the piano. That night, NJ phones and leaves a message for Sherry, apologizing for leaving her abruptly 30 years ago. NJ is sent by his company to Tokyo to continue talks with Ota. Sherry also flies to Japan, and the two reunite and recount their past.
